title: Irish Skillet Crispy Chilli Hash
description: A hearty skillet hash made with crispy chilli, crunchy potatoes, and a hint of irish flair.
instructions: Heat the skillet oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and cook until they begin to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced chilli and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and stir to combine with the chilli and onions.
Cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are crispy and golden brown.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
